known_scope: Native extents are pinned to original PE bytes; native non-CALL text is not independently redecoded. Derived instructions and finite CALL/code-pointer anchors are individually checked.
36 complete original records are factory validated one at a time. One same-entry alternative remains separate. Four new observations exactly duplicate retained records and add no semantic coverage.
Source rules concern the fixed37c4 sample and original7810 profile; seeded views have a separate authority and no fabricated native profile.
Typed incoming writes are finite Ghidra references, not complete alias or runtime write coverage. Comparator bodies do not establish host sort stability.
Group-mail routes, selected predicate dependencies, all cache-directory lifecycle, modern selector resets, current release/platform/device and official acceptance remain open.
No original execution, VM, real contacts/mail/cache/account reads, product changes/tests/builds, devices or official session.
